svg.aria-label: Breadboard: Pico across the trench with USB on the left. VBUS (pin 40) jumpered to the plus rail, GND (pin 38) to the minus rail. GP2 (pin 4) jumpered to column 24, then a 330 ohm resistor to column 28, then the green data wire to the panel DIN. A 1000 microfarad capacitor sits across the plus and minus rails. The panel 5V (red) and GND (white) wires come from the rails.
svg.text: GP2 (pin 4) → j24, 330 Ω h24–h28, i28 → panel DIN
